messages:
Maria: Morning team — async standup for gateway/routing/auth/rlimits.

Maria: Yesterday I rolled a small canary for gateway v2 routing rules (8% traffic). Noticed p99 latency creeping for long-context requests (~>2500 tokens). Worked with Sam to collect spans.

Sam: Repro'd locally by firing 200 requests with seq ~3k; saw ~25% p99 bump. Opened PR #523 to tweak batching thresholds (idle timeout 12ms -> 6ms). Added benchmark logs.

Sam: Also saw a handful of 502s from /v1/complete; upstream model-hosts reported connection resets. Tagged @Tanvi for infra investigation.

Leo: Auth update: rotation endpoint ready but awaiting cert propagation on the proxy. DNS/edge certs should settle after the cert deploy. ETA ~90m.

Leo: Proposed auth config (will push as flag):
```
auth:
  mode: enforce
  jwks_url: https://auth-int.redwood/.well-known/jwks.json
  allow_unsigned: false
```

Tanvi: Infra update — one overloaded model-host node was restarted and removed from LB. Monitoring shows tail recovery. I'll follow up if the connection resets recur. Also pushing certs at 10:45 UTC.

dev-deploy-bot: Canary: gateway-v2 routing-rollout started by Maria at 2026-03-17T09:12Z. Targets: 6 instances (1 canary). Health: passing 5/6.

Maria: Sam — can you add a tiny synthetic that exercises >2k token path to PR #523? A single smoke check in CI will catch regressions.

Sam: Added a smoke test and updated the PR description.

Leo: Once certs are active I'll drop a note and we can flip enforce auth. Ping me in 2h if no update.

Maria: Blockers: cert propagation (Leo/Tanvi), monitor p99 on long-seq, hold canary expansion until stable. If you see >1% 5xx, alert #eng-oncall and tag @Tanvi.

Tanvi: noted, watching metrics and will escalate as needed. :eyes:

Maria: Small routing tweak scheduled later: prefer local low-latency pools for short sequences (<512). Config snippet:
```
routing:
  - match: seq_len < 512
    prefer_pool: low-latency
  - otherwise: prefer_pool: balanced
```

Sam: +1

Leo: +1

Maria: Thanks — keep replies short. I'll update thread when we flip auth enforce. :rocket:
